mechanism_findings.laurent_q5_source_mechanism: Flatten recurrent GDN ssm_out input from [6144,n_seq_tokens,n_seqs] to [6144,n_seq_tokens*n_seqs] before projection, replacing per-sequence MMVQ with batch-wide MMQ.
mechanism_findings.note: The matched-output profile isolates a peer mechanism without output drift. The separate known-different C8 cell proves equal requested K3 does not imply equal generated/accepted drafts or equal work.

candidate_ranking.candidate: production-profile batch-wide Q5 matrix tile/MMQ analogue for R24/R32 with current exact grouped Q5 fallback
candidate_ranking.evidence: Laurent source commit 25748619 and direct matched-output trace replace current MMVQ with MMQ.
candidate_ranking.estimate_formula: hipEngine mean Q5 cycle wall * (1 - Laurent matched-output Q5 wall / current matched-output Q5 wall)
candidate_ranking.binding_gate: exact control/ownership plus full T1/T2 production numerical, deterministic/isolation, BF16-relative, task, lifecycle and complete-suite perf gates

limitations: Peer traces are one-prompt diagnostics, not replacement throughput rows.
Raw rocprof CSV stays under /tmp and is represented by path plus SHA-256.
The arithmetic-difference probe uses one of the two known Laurent-different C8 cells; it is retained only to prove work/acceptance non-equivalence.
